chunks: That God may reward them for the best of their deeds, and bestow more on them of His bounty, for God gives whom He please without measure.

key_terms.أَحْسَنَ مَا عَمِلُوا۟: The best of what they did
key_terms.يَزِيدَهُم مِّن فَضْلِهِۦ: And increase them from His bounty

ai.seo_question: How does God reward the righteous and provide sustenance without limit?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse underscores the concept of 'Ziyadah' (increase), where God rewards the best of deeds with even greater grace beyond mere equivalence, reflecting His boundless generosity. It highlights that divine sustenance (rizq) is not limited by human calculation but is bestowed according to God's will, reinforcing the believer's reliance on His infinite bounty.
